@@U00250@@
you proved yourself the people's friend. Many a man among us has your father to thank for his life. When burning fever raged, your father snatched many of us from the grip of death when he put an end to the pestilence. Young as you were, you entered each house, no matter the danger; and though many a corpse left feet first, you always emerged from every dwelling, safe and sound, and shouldered many bitter trials, the helper helped by the Helper on high.

@@U00252@@
Let’s drink health to this trusty man! Long may he live to help in our need!

@@U00254@@
Bow your heads to Him Who teaches us to help the helpless!

@@U00255@@
(浮士德 and 瓦格纳 go on.)

@@U00257@@
Great man, what a joy you must feel to have such reverence from the masses! Happy the man who from his talents can reap so grand a reward! Fathers point you out to their sons, all ask questions, crowd around you, jostle for room, the fiddles stop, the dancers pause, and as you pass on by they stand in rows and caps go flying. It wouldn’t take much to make them kneel as if the Host were seen approaching.
translation:
@@U00250@@
你证明了自己是人民的朋友。我们当中很多人的一生都要感谢你的父亲。当高烧肆虐时，你的父亲消灭了瘟疫，将我们许多人从死亡的魔掌中救了出来。尽管你还年轻，你还是走进了每一栋房子，不顾危险；尽管许多尸体先离开了脚，但你总是从每一个住所中出来，安然无恙，并肩负着许多痛苦的考验，是高处的帮助者所帮助的帮助者。

@@U00252@@
让我们为这个值得信赖的人干杯健康吧！愿他长寿，为我们的需要提供帮助！

@@U00254@@
请向教导我们帮助无助者的主低头！

@@U00255@@
（浮士德和瓦格纳继续。）

@@U00257@@
伟人，能受到群众的如此崇敬，该是何等的快乐啊！能凭借自己的才华获得如此丰厚的回报的人真是太幸福了！父亲们把你指给他们的儿子们，所有人都问问题，挤在你周围，争夺空间，小提琴停止，舞者停顿，当你经过时，他们排成一排，帽子飞扬。不需要太多的功夫就能让他们跪下，就好像宿主正在接近一样。
